nodes.label: Chip
nodes.rationale: Corner md. Active fill is the role color and the text follows the luminance rule. Idle fill is the role color at alpha 0x18.

nodes.label: Dock
nodes.rationale: Fill is the nav layer token. The active tab is foreground plus a primary line. The idle tab is muted-foreground. Related measures are nav height 100 dp, fab 88 dp, and radial node 48 dp.

nodes.label: Emobilize Design System
nodes.rationale: Visual system for Emobilize. Color tokens come from the shadcn registry @shadcn/theme-neutral, type is Montserrat, and layout units follow the Tailwind scale used by shadcn. Code sources are Shadcn.kt, Palette.kt, Type.kt, Metrics.kt, and Theme.kt.

nodes.label: Input
nodes.rationale: Corner lg, fill background, 1 dp input border, destructive border when invalid, primary cursor, muted-foreground placeholder.

nodes.label: Neutral Dark
nodes.rationale: Near-black palette, code name NeutralDark. Status bar and navigation bar are light.

nodes.label: Neutral Light

nodes.label: Sheet
nodes.rationale: Top corners xl, fill popover, 1 dp border, scrim from the layer tokens. The close control is a secondary circle with a secondary-foreground icon.

nodes.label: Toggle
nodes.rationale: Corner md. Active state uses primary fill and border with primary-foreground text. Idle state is a transparent fill, a border line, and muted-foreground text.

nodes.label: Categories
nodes.rationale: Copy: Edit up to 3 categories and choose a color for each. The 3 is Category.Limit. Defaults are Study, Work, and Health. A closed row shows a color dot, the name, and an edit icon (Edit plus the name). An open row has placeholder Category name and five colors. Initial ARGB use: #E76E50 Study, #2A9D90 Health, #F4A462 Work, plus #274754 and #E8C468. A name must be 1 to 24 characters and must not contain the separators U+001E and U+001F. Invalid copy is Category names must be 1–24 characters, and Save Changes disables. Categories are not added from the UI; only the name and color of the three existing slots change.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.rationale: domain/model/Task.kt. Fields: id, name, nullable category, deadline (empty string means no date), display time like 10:30 AM which may be empty, filterKey, nullable priority, range (dates plus start and end clocks in 09:00 form), eventType, and eventEndTime. Shared by every mounted page.

nodes.label: TaskCard
nodes.rationale: Shows a category stripe, a priority badge, and a date only when those fields exist.

nodes.label: Chart tokens
nodes.rationale: chart-1 is Study and in-progress, chart-2 is Health, done, and low priority, chart-3 is University and the update action, chart-4 is Personal, medium priority, and the edit action, chart-5 is Work. Light and dark hues differ; light chart-3 is #274754 and dark chart-3 is #E88C30.

nodes.label: Neutral color tokens
nodes.rationale: Shared names across both palettes: background, foreground, card, card-foreground, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, secondary-foreground, muted, muted-foreground, accent, accent-foreground, destructive, destructive-foreground, border, input, ring, and chart-1 through chart-5. Card and page background use the same color and are separated by a 1 dp border, not by a lighter card fill.

nodes.label: Layer tokens
nodes.rationale: scrim, nav, shadow, and text-subtle. scrim is black at 40 percent in light and 62 percent in dark, over the radial menu and sheets. nav is background at 96 percent light and 97 percent dark for the bottom dock. shadow is black at 6 percent light and 35 percent dark. text-subtle is muted-foreground at 62 percent for completed tasks. Text on a fill uses ink when luminance is above 0.72, otherwise on-dark #FAFAFA.

nodes.label: Primary button
nodes.rationale: Height 44 dp, corner lg, fill is the action color, and the label follows the luminance of that fill.

nodes.label: shadcn radius scale
nodes.rationale: Base --radius is 0.5rem (8 dp). sm is radius minus 4 (4 dp) for small controls, md is radius minus 2 (6 dp) for chips, badges, and toggles, lg is the radius (8 dp) for buttons, inputs, and date fields, xl is radius plus 4 (12 dp) for task cards and the top corners of sheets. A selected card outer corner is xl plus 4 dp.

nodes.label: @shadcn/theme-neutral
nodes.rationale: Upstream registry the palettes copy. Values are stored as HSL, the same way the registry stores them. Hex figures in the tables are sRGB conversions, not the stored form.

nodes.label: Spacing scale
nodes.rationale: Tailwind-like steps in dp: px 1, 1 is 4, 2 is 8, 3 is 12, 4 is 16, 5 is 20, 6 is 24, 8 is 32, 10 is 40. Screen measures already in use: header-horizontal 24, page-horizontal 18, card min height 68, action height 44, nav height 100, fab 88, radial node 48.

nodes.label: Task card
nodes.rationale: Corner xl (12 dp), fill card, 1 dp border when idle, 2 dp action color when selected, elevation from the shadow token.

nodes.label: Theme settings
nodes.rationale: Settings offers System, Light, and Dark. The header gear icon opens Settings. The document maps Neutral Light and Neutral Dark but does not say which palette System selects.

nodes.label: Product color roles
nodes.rationale: Product colors are not independent. Each role points at a chart token or destructive. Status todo is muted-foreground, progress is chart-1, done is chart-2. Categories: Study chart-1, Work chart-5, Health chart-2, Personal chart-4, University chart-3. Priority low is chart-2, medium chart-4, high destructive. Actions: add primary, update chart-3, edit chart-4, delete destructive. Selected fills are a low alpha of the role color with a stronger stroke.

nodes.label: LocalPalette
nodes.rationale: Screen colors come from LocalPalette.current in ui/theme/Palette.kt. Only two themes exist: NeutralLight (id 1) and NeutralDark (id 2). Do not add another palette.

nodes.label: NeutralDark
nodes.rationale: Dark palette, theme id 2.

nodes.label: NeutralLight
nodes.rationale: Light palette, theme id 1.

nodes.label: SettingsScreen
nodes.rationale: App preferences and categories. The gear icon in the header opens Settings. Theme is changed only from Settings.

nodes.label: Shadcn scheme
nodes.rationale: palette.scheme from ui/theme/Shadcn.kt supplies background, popover, border, and card.

nodes.label: AppSettings
nodes.rationale: themeMode, defaultCalendarView, weekStart, defaultCategoryId, defaultPriority, and showCompletedTasks. Settings save writes this after the changed categories.

nodes.label: Calendar settings
nodes.rationale: Default view help: Choose the view shown when you open Calendar. Chip order is Week, Day, Month. Week starts on help: Use the same first day in Month and Week views. Choices are Monday and Sunday.

nodes.label: deadlineRank
nodes.rationale: Sort key used inside To-do and In progress. The Done group is not reordered by it.

nodes.label: Task defaults
nodes.rationale: Default category help: Preselect a category when adding a task (None plus each category). Default priority help: Preselect a priority when adding a task (None, Low, Medium, High). Show completed tasks help: Keep the Done section visible on the Tasks screen.

nodes.label: Task sections
nodes.rationale: Non-empty groups are To-do, In progress, and Done. Done is hidden when Settings Show completed tasks is off. Empty copy is No tasks in this view. The counter is completed visible tasks, a slash, then visible tasks, computed from data (shape 2 / 8), not fixed text. Inside To-do and In progress, order uses deadlineRank; Done is not re-sorted.

nodes.label: Theme setting
nodes.rationale: Help text Choose how Emobilize looks. Choices are System, Light, and Dark. AppSettings.themeMode: System uses the system theme, Light uses NeutralLight, Dark uses NeutralDark. The default setting is Light.

nodes.label: AppFont
nodes.rationale: Text uses appStyle(...) and AppFont in ui/theme/Type.kt. The font is Montserrat, shipped under res/font/.

nodes.label: AppMetrics
nodes.rationale: Spacing and card sizes in ui/theme/Metrics.kt. cardRadius, cardMinHeight, pageHorizontal 18.dp, and headerHorizontal 24.dp.

nodes.label: Offline Kotlin compile
nodes.rationale: Verification command is .\gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin --offline. adb is not on PATH, so a successful compile does not mean the UI was tried on a device.

nodes.label: Emobilize
nodes.rationale: Android Kotlin and Jetpack Compose task-and-calendar app, package ayodong.emobilize, single Gradle module :app, minSdk 28, compileSdk and targetSdk 37. Branch tasks-radial-menu, remote https://github.com/Hzxon/Emobilize. It is not React, Tailwind, or Figma Make; the user-level AGENTS.md belongs to a different web project and should be ignored.

nodes.label: Frozen English UI strings
nodes.rationale: Existing English UI copy stays as written, including Title, Close, Tasks, Calendar, and Nothing scheduled.

nodes.label: Layered architecture
nodes.rationale: UI goes to ViewModel, then use case, then a repository interface, then data. The domain layer does not import Compose. TasksViewModel is the only ViewModel and re-reads the repository after a write.

nodes.label: UI-only change rule
nodes.rationale: Change appearance only. Do not change save behavior, filters, or architecture, and do not build the task list or calendar blocks from a Composable. UI sources live under app/src/main/java/ayodong/emobilize/ui/; colors, type, and sizes live in ui/theme/ and DESIGN.md. After edits, run .\gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin --offline.

nodes.label: CalendarScreen
nodes.rationale: Calendar header and Month, Week, and Day bodies, plus the card list. File ui/calendar/CalendarScreen.kt. Composables CalendarScreen, DayAgenda, and AgendaRow.

nodes.label: EventType
nodes.rationale: Event, Task, or Regular Schedule. Calendar task rows show this kind along with category and optional priority.

nodes.label: Calendar task card
nodes.rationale: A task is placed on a day by taskOccursOn: the deadline date, or a date inside the range. The card shows the title, EventType (Event, Task, or Regular Schedule), category if present, priority if present, and a time label that may be a clock time, a time range, or a date.

nodes.label: Day view
nodes.rationale: Full weekday name and date number, with Previous day and Next day arrows. There is no grid; the agenda fills the remaining screen.

nodes.label: Month view
nodes.rationale: Grid of the visible month. Single-letter weekday names in the US locale. Cells outside the month are empty. A small dot marks a day that has a task or block. Today has a ring. The selected day is filled with primary. The selected day's agenda sits under the grid.

nodes.label: taskOccursOn
nodes.rationale: Decides whether a task falls on a calendar day: a single deadline date, or any date inside its range.

nodes.label: Week view
nodes.rationale: Seven days of the active date's week, short weekday names, a dot when the day has items. Tapping a day changes the agenda. The header month does not move just because the selected day changes.

nodes.label: Calendar agenda
nodes.rationale: Month, Week, and Day put a vertical card list under the date picker, not an hour grid. Items sort by start time; items with no time go below. An empty day reads Nothing scheduled.

nodes.label: In-memory data
nodes.rationale: Task and calendar data live in memory and disappear when the process dies. Sample content is in data/repository/SampleData.kt.

nodes.label: SampleData
nodes.rationale: Initial in-memory sample tasks and schedule in data/repository/SampleData.kt.

nodes.label: In-memory repositories
nodes.rationale: Tasks, calendar blocks, categories, and settings stay in memory through repositories and are lost when the process dies. Initial samples are in data/repository/SampleData.kt. Visible UI copy is English.

nodes.label: Local Compile Verification
nodes.rationale: Each feature is checked with gradlew assembleDebug or compileDebugKotlin before it is merged into the working branch.

nodes.label: Light splash letter E mark
nodes.rationale: Dark charcoal bars on a fully transparent canvas so the letter E can sit on the light splash surface beside the word MOBILIZE.

nodes.label: Montserrat
nodes.rationale: Font files are montserrat_regular, montserrat_medium, montserrat_semibold, and montserrat_bold. The scale in sp is xs 12/16, sm 14/20, base 16/24, lg 18/28, xl 20/28, 2xl 24/32, 3xl 30/36, 4xl 36/40. Regular is for screen titles and body, Medium for labels, SemiBold for task names and field values, Bold for tabs, filters, chips, and buttons. Section labels are uppercase with about 0.1 em letter-spacing.

nodes.label: Design System and Theming
nodes.rationale: Standardized tokens inspired by Shadcn, Montserrat through appStyle(), and dynamic light and dark mode.

nodes.label: Clean Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: The app is built entirely with Jetpack Compose and split into UI, Domain, and Data/DI so each layer has a separate responsibility.

nodes.label: Separation of Concerns
nodes.rationale: Work is divided along the layered architecture mapped by Graphify so each member owns one concern.

nodes.label: BottomDock
nodes.rationale: Bottom dock with the Tasks and Calendar tabs, the center button face, and the theme orb. File ui/dock/RadialDock.kt. Composables BottomDock, FabFace, and ThemeOrb.

nodes.label: EmobilizeApp
nodes.rationale: Arranges every screen and decides when a form appears. File ui/EmobilizeApp.kt.

nodes.label: menuColor
nodes.rationale: Radial action colors: Add green, Update blue, Edit actionEdit, Delete danger.

nodes.label: RadialMenu
nodes.rationale: Fan of Add, Update, Edit, and Delete opened by the center button. Update is hidden on the Calendar tab. Open and close use a spring with dampingRatio 0.75 and Spring.StiffnessMediumLow: the fan grows from the hub, buttons rise from the dock, and the icon rotates 90 degrees. Do not replace these actions with a navigation menu.

nodes.label: ThemeOrb
nodes.rationale: Named as a dock composable next to the center button. Theme changes are also specified to happen only from Settings, so the orb's role as a control versus a status mark is not settled in this guide.

nodes.label: Application shell
nodes.rationale: Three layers are always present: a top bar with an empty left side and a 44 dp gear (content description Settings), the tab body (TasksScreen or CalendarScreen), and BottomDock. The gear closes the radial menu and opens Settings. The initial tab is Tasks. Switching tabs closes the radial menu and clears the calendar block selection. Entering Calendar while Update is pending cancels Update, because Update does not exist on Calendar. Dock background uses navBg.

nodes.label: Auth error messages
nodes.rationale: Invalid name: Enter your name. Invalid email: Enter a valid email. Password under 6 characters: Use at least 6 characters. Email already registered: That email is already registered. Bad login: Email or password is incorrect. Confirm mismatch: Passwords do not match.

nodes.label: AuthScreen
nodes.rationale: File ui/auth/AuthScreen.kt. Present in code but not mounted: MainActivity does not create AuthViewModel and does not show the screen, and EmobilizeApp does not install it. Login (AuthPage.Login) shows title Emobilize, subtitle Log in to continue, Email, a hidden Password, Log in, and Need an account? Register. Register shows Create an account, Name, Email, Password, Confirm password, Create account, and Already have an account? Log in; back returns to Login. Success only sets signedIn on the ViewModel. There is no navigation to Tasks.

nodes.label: AuthViewModel
nodes.rationale: Produces the auth failure messages and the signedIn flag. MainActivity never creates it, and a successful sign-in does not navigate anywhere.

nodes.label: Radial menu
nodes.rationale: Files ui/dock/RadialMenu.kt and ui/dock/RadialDock.kt. The center button opens the fan. Base angles and theme colors: Add at -87 degrees green, Update at 0 degrees blue, Edit at a display angle of -30 degrees on both tabs using actionEdit, Delete at 87 degrees danger. On Calendar, Update is not drawn. On Tasks, Update shifts to 30 degrees and Edit to -30 degrees. Open and close use a spring with dampingRatio 0.75 and Spring.StiffnessMediumLow. The fan grows from the hub, buttons rise from the dock, and icons rotate 90 degrees. A haptic fires when the selection changes. An outside tap or back closes the menu without choosing an action. The dock does not replace other pages; it only selects Tasks or Calendar.

nodes.label: System back order
nodes.rationale: System back dismisses the topmost layer first: Settings, then the Add card, then the calendar form, then the task edit sheet, then the radial menu, then cancels the block selection and any pending Edit, Delete, or Update.

nodes.label: Interactive Radial Menu
nodes.rationale: A gesture radial action fan opens add, update, edit, and delete without leaving the current flow.

nodes.label: Spring Animation
nodes.rationale: Spring physics keeps the radial fan responsive when it opens CRUD actions.

nodes.label: :app:assembleDebug
nodes.rationale: Builds the debug APK as the last step of the check job, after unit tests.

nodes.label: check
nodes.rationale: Job name is Build, test, and resolve dependencies. It runs on ubuntu-latest with a 30 minute timeout and contents read permission. Gradle calls use --stacktrace. The job does not submit a dependency graph.

nodes.label: CI
nodes.rationale: Runs on every push and every pull request. One workflow holds a verification job and a separate dependency-graph submission job.

nodes.label: dependency-graph
nodes.rationale: Submits the Gradle dependency graph only when the event is a push and the ref is refs/heads/main, so pull requests do not submit. It needs contents write. Test and lint configurations are excluded, and the configuration cache is turned off for the submission.

nodes.label: Gradle dependency submission
nodes.rationale: Uses gradle/actions/dependency-submission@v6 with additional-arguments --no-configuration-cache and dependency-graph-exclude-configurations matching test or lint. This action replaces the setup-gradle step used by the check job.

nodes.label: :app:resolveCiDependencies
nodes.rationale: First Gradle step of the check job. It resolves the app module dependencies before tests and APK assembly.

nodes.label: :app:testDebugUnitTest
nodes.rationale: Debug unit-test task for the app module. It runs after dependency resolution and before the debug APK is assembled.

nodes.label: Android SDK
nodes.rationale: Both jobs install the Android SDK with android-actions/setup-android@v4. The check job also sets up Gradle with gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6; the dependency-graph job does not.

nodes.label: JDK 25 Temurin
nodes.rationale: Both jobs set up Temurin JDK 25 with actions/setup-java@v5 before any Gradle step.

nodes.label: Cancel in-progress CI
nodes.rationale: The concurrency group is the workflow name plus the git ref. cancel-in-progress is true so a newer push or pull request replaces a stale run of this workflow on that ref.

nodes.label: ExpandableReminderCard
nodes.rationale: File ui/notifications/ExpandableReminderCard.kt. Not imported by any screen, so its actions are not wired to storage. Collapsed it shows the logo, the label Emobilize, the task name, and a time. The due line is the fixed text Due in 30 mins followed by task.time, or Scheduled time when the time is empty. The 30 minutes is not computed from the deadline. Expanding rotates the chevron 180 degrees; the content description is Expand or Collapse. Mark as done calls onMarkDone then closes. Reschedule calls onReschedule then closes.

nodes.label: Reminder Option (None, At deadline, 10 minutes before, 1 hour before, 1 day before)
nodes.norm_label: reminder option (none, at deadline, 10 minutes before, 1 hour before, 1 day before)

nodes.label: Composable state boundary
nodes.rationale: Composables may own only themeId, the active tab, and menuOpen. Task and block persistence stays out of Composables; data state lives in TasksViewModel. Card color and spacing changes should not open the ViewModel.

nodes.label: TasksViewModel
nodes.rationale: The only ViewModel. Owns task data state and TaskDraft, re-reads the repository after writes, and deletes a selected calendar block through deleteSelectedBlock().

nodes.label: TasksViewModelFactory
nodes.rationale: Factory passed the AppContainer so MainActivity can construct TasksViewModel without a DI framework.

nodes.label: God Node
nodes.rationale: Graphify flags TasksViewModel, appStyle(), and AppContainer as god nodes.

nodes.label: Manual composition root
nodes.rationale: MainActivity creates AppContainer, then viewModel(factory = TasksViewModelFactory(container)). There is no Hilt. Do not add a dependency-injection library.

nodes.label: Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: UI state and data mutations stay reactive in TasksViewModel and AppContainer so leaf composables do not hold ad-hoc state.

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Graphify mapped 849+ nodes and 2240+ edges, detected god nodes, and was used to confirm the dependency graph has no cycles.

nodes.rationale: Compiled on 22 October 2026 from the codebase architecture and the Graphify knowledge graph.

nodes.label: AddTaskCard
nodes.rationale: Add card on the Tasks tab only. The calendar tab uses CalendarFormSheet instead, and editing an existing task uses TaskFormSheet, not this card.

nodes.label: CalendarFormSheet
nodes.rationale: Add and edit form on the Calendar tab. Add offers only Event and Regular Schedule; Task is absent. When editing an existing item, the type is locked to that item's kind.

nodes.label: deleteSelectedBlock
nodes.rationale: Edit and Delete select a card. Removing a calendar block goes through TasksViewModel.deleteSelectedBlock().

nodes.label: Task
nodes.rationale: domain/model/Task.kt. category and priority may be null. An empty deadline means no date. range is the time range. eventType is Event, Task, or Regular Schedule. time and eventEndTime look like 10:30 AM; range clock fields look like 09:00.

nodes.label: Task filters
nodes.rationale: All, Today, Tomorrow, and Later. A task with no schedule appears only in All.

nodes.label: TaskDraft
nodes.rationale: Lives in TasksViewModel.kt because its fields are mutableStateOf. Do not move TaskDraft into domain.

nodes.label: TaskFormSheet
nodes.rationale: Full edit sheet for an existing task, with DateField and TimeField. It is not AddTaskCard.

nodes.label: TasksScreen
nodes.rationale: Task list, filters, and task cards. File ui/tasks/TasksScreen.kt. Composables TasksScreen and TaskCard.

nodes.label: TimeBlock
nodes.rationale: id, title, start, end as decimal hours, and category. Stored per LocalDate. A calendar block is shown as Regular Schedule with category and start-to-end time.

nodes.label: Calendar selection actions
nodes.rationale: Update is not used on Calendar: the Update wedge is hidden, and a leftover Update is cancelled on entry. Add opens a new CalendarFormSheet with initial type Event. Edit shows Select a calendar item to edit; a task opens the form filled with that task, and a block opens a locked Regular Schedule form with the block date and start and end. Delete shows Select a calendar item to delete, then Delete calendar item. Without Edit or Delete, tapping a task card does nothing, while tapping a block still toggles block selection. Unselected cards dim while selection mode is active. Cancel clears the task selection, the block selection, and the pending action.

nodes.label: canSubmitCalendar
nodes.rationale: Gate for the calendar sheet save button. The button stays disabled until this is true.

nodes.label: Category.Limit
nodes.rationale: The maximum of three editable category slots. The UI does not create additional categories.

nodes.label: confirmAction
nodes.rationale: Deletes a selected calendar task. A selected block is not deleted through this path.

nodes.label: Event form
nodes.rationale: Date and Time with a date, Start, and End (the time may be empty), plus Category. Save requires a title and a date. The result is stored as a task, not an hour block.

nodes.label: Regular Schedule form
nodes.rationale: FROM and TO on a single date; the block editor fills the same date for start and end, with the same range validation. Save writes a TimeBlock: title, decimal hours, and category. An empty category becomes Work. A new id is the current time in milliseconds; an existing id is kept on edit.

nodes.label: Calendar task edit form
nodes.rationale: Shown only when editing an item that is already a Task. Fields are Category, Priority (Low, Medium, High), and Schedule as Deadline (Time is optional) or Time range (FROM, TO, and End time must be after start time).

nodes.label: Task date filters
nodes.rationale: All, Today, Tomorrow, Later. The active chip uses background. All includes unscheduled tasks. Today, Tomorrow, and Later: a task without a time range follows filterKey; a task with a range matches when the range covers that day. Later means the range end date is still after tomorrow. A task with no date appears only in All.

nodes.label: Tasks radial actions
nodes.rationale: Add opens AddTaskCard and resets the draft as a Task. Update shows Select a card to update status, then Progress or Done under Set status. Edit shows Select a card to edit, then Edit task opens TaskFormSheet. Delete shows Select a card to delete, then Delete task removes the task. Cancel on the banner clears the action and the selection.

nodes.label: Time block card
nodes.rationale: Shows the block title, a line starting with Regular Schedule then the category name, start to end times, and a category color bar on the left.

nodes.label: updateTask
nodes.rationale: Save Changes on the task edit sheet writes the same task id.

nodes.label: Notification Quick Actions (Mark as Done, Reschedule)
nodes.norm_label: notification quick actions (mark as done, reschedule)

nodes.label: Add task behavior
nodes.rationale: The title is focused and the keyboard opens. Optional icons are Category, Priority, and Schedule (Deadline or Time range). Tapping the active choice clears it. Add task saves only when the title is filled. Close, an outside tap, or back discards. An invalid time range opens the Schedule panel and does not save.

nodes.label: Legacy model package
nodes.rationale: model/TaskModels.kt and model/CalendarModels.kt are old duplicates and are not imported. Live models are in domain/model/. Do not edit the legacy files.
